ui.access_tip_1: Use the “Skip to main content” link at the start of each page to bypass navigation.
ui.access_tip_2: Navigate links and buttons with your keyboard. On smaller screens, open the Menu button to reveal navigation; Escape closes it.
ui.access_tip_3: Text and layouts are designed to resize and reflow. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
ui.access_tip_4: The website follows the light or dark appearance preference supplied by your browser or operating system.
ui.access_tip_5: The contact page displays our email address as a link you can activate or copy into your preferred email service, along with our phone number.
ui.access_tip_language: Use the English and Español links in the header to open the equivalent page in the other language.

ui.barrier_after: It helps to include the page, the task you were trying to complete, and your browser or assistive technology if you wish.
